basic_info.description: This well appointed two-story house on a hilltop boasts pride of ownership with its open living / dining area, four legal bedrooms (two en-suite), three modern bathrooms, and two-level deck overlooking stunning views of the bay. The entry level is flexible space for friends, family, work, or play. Nearly every detail of this house has been thoughtfully addressed, including custom-built closets and drawers, air conditioning, and water pressure pump. Located close to Hilltop Park, Bayview Opera House, Flora Grubb Gardens, Tato, All Good Pizza, and the 3rd Street Corridor; the optimal microclimate and friendly neighbors make this house an amazing home.
